summary: a tab is no longer whitespace but a one-byte error token
instruction: Change request for the A0 front end (lexer and parser): a tab byte (9) must no longer be skipped as whitespace. It becomes a one-byte error token (kind 9, like any other byte the lexer does not know). Spaces (32) and carriage returns (13) are still skipped.
